member.name: F:Microsoft.Engineering.VPack.Model.DataTypes.DeploymentManifest.MaxSupportedFormatVersion
member.summary: The max supported format version.

remarks.para: For deployment manifest format V1, we have one predefined metadata value for the manifest format version. Every other name=value pair that we encounter is treated as a replacement macro (a la NMAKE's $(ReplacementMacro)).
Kinds of deployment manifest format changes that require some thought w.r.t format versioning:
remarks.list: A breaking change to the CSV format (i.e., rearrangements, new or deleted fields, field types etc). A commonly defined replacement macro that requires some special sauce and must be recognized for additional metadata processing A non-breaking change to metadata, such that if a deployment manifest were to be read by older code, it would be harmlessly unrecognized and added to the replacement macro list, where it simply takes up space or could collide with .
remarks.para: ALWAYS THROW A FATAL EXCEPTION WHEN Manifest_Format_Version > _maxSupportedFormatVersion. Old code should never try to process a deployment manifest with a newer version.
